episodes.description: In 1959, nine experienced hikers perished in the Ural Mountains under bizarre, inexplicable circumstances that left their tent slashed from the inside. Decades later, investigators remain divided between theories of freak weather phenomena and forces that defy logical explanation.
episodes.title: The Wow! Signal: The Mystery of Dyatlov Pass
The Wow! Signal: The Mystery of the Mary Celeste
episodes.description: Discovered adrift in the Atlantic Ocean in 1872, the Mary Celeste was found completely abandoned with its cargo intact and personal belongings left behind. To this day, the total disappearance of its crew remains one of the most haunting and enduring maritime puzzles in naval history.

episodes.title: The Wow! Signal: D.B. Cooper — The Man Who Vanished Mid-Air
episodes.description: In 1971, a man hijacked Flight 305, took $200,000, and parachuted into the night — never to be seen again. The FBI's only unsolved air piracy case.

episodes.title: The Wow! Signal: The Somerton Man — The Code No One Could Crack
episodes.description: In 1948, a man was found dead on an Australian beach with no ID — and a scrap of paper in his pocket that read 'Tamám Shud.' It is finished. The code in the book was never cracked.

episodes.title: The Wow! Signal: The Zodiac Killer — The Cipher That Took 51 Years to Crack
episodes.description: Between 1968 and 1969, a killer terrorized the San Francisco Bay Area — then mailed his crimes to the newspapers in code. One cipher took 51 years to crack. It named no one.
